delivery.outcome: Every diagnostic a command can raise is declared by that command and documented, and the declaration is derived from the validator rather than kept by hand
nonGoals: No change to the operations registry as the source of truth; commands, events and projections keep their shape
No registration of authoring diagnostics as command rejections; CQRS-* and MRG-CONTRACT-001 refuse a malformed standard, not a request
No new document family and no runtime dependency

architecture.decision: Derive each command's rejection set from its validator with the ast module and assert it equals the registry, so the surface cannot drift silently when a rule is added
interfaceChanges: command rejects lists grow to the codes their validation already raised
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket; the previous registry described a narrower surface than the checker enforced

validation.evidence: The CQRS suite passes with the completed rejects lists and the error catalogue still closes over them exactly
The decision suite passes and reports the derived rejection surface per command

commands: python3 - <<'EOF'  # drop one declared code and re-run
validation.evidence: Removing a code from the registry is rejected with MRG-CQRS-001 rather than passing silently
